claims.statement: For a uniform full-production secp256k1 input Q=[x]P, the classical cold six-class negation-plus-GLV parallel Pollard-rho attack described in proof.md and upstream-proof.md halts on every run with total work at most 2^126.2165 target-group-operation equivalents under classical-group-work-v2 (C=1000). The H1 calibration and Markov headroom are unchanged from 02feb284 (slowdown allowance kappa=1.01, Markov headroom h=0.003866; q29 census: mean slowdown +0.6968%, pooled s.e. 0.1169%); the floor p0 at S_ops/kappa is lowered from 0.3939163 to 0.39389. Recovery probability is greater than 0.3900238 and therefore at least 0.39. Peak memory is below 2^72 bytes; preprocessing is capped at 2^59 units, charged and included; nonuniform advice is zero. The ordinary step is repriced from 744 to 699 instructions. The counted AArch64 loops are 108 (pass 1) and 493 (pass 2): fe_mul is 88 (32 products, 30 additions in six carry chains, and a 26-instruction reduction whose final C0 fold touches two limbs because after a carry out of the second fold the value left is below 2^65), fe_sqr is 67, x3 and y3 use a fused 14-instruction subtract-and-canonicalise, R stays in registers across iterations and y(W) is loaded once (register peak 25, no spills). experiment.py's interpreter, extended by the A64 forms CSNEG and ADDS with an LSL-shifted register, executes the shipped loops with zero mismatches and the shipped emitters on edge inputs, including reductions whose final fold fires. The analytic rows are 98: p - y from two constant registers (17 -> 13), the fingerprint ring and trail length with LDP/STP (26 -> 22, 13 -> 11), and the zero-denominator test moved to once per batch (4 -> 0). Doubling is 907 (729 + 98 + 50 + 30) and traversal 723 (699 + 24). Exact ledger: phase 1 = 2^126.206591, hard extras = 2^107.155501, expected random extras = 2^111.008976, allowance = ceil(extras/0.003866) = 2^119.02392, total W_ledger = 2^126.2164901 < 2^126.2165; the exact Markov ratio is 0.00386214 < 0.003866. certificate.py proves the bound in exact integer and rational arithmetic, including W^10000 < 1000^10000*2^1262165 and W^10000 > 1000^10000*2^1262164. The claim is self-contained in proof.md; no prior acceptance, review verdict, official score or cross-submission comparison is a premise. The construction and H1 calibration are credited as provenance and declared as a dependency on submission 02feb284. This is an analytic heuristic bound, not a practical break or executed production attack.

experiments.purpose: Part A: production secp256k1 checks of the walk identities and truncated canonical-index rule; Part B: a scaled sequential toy pipeline on configured subgroups of y^2=x^3+7 with an unreduced subgroup-order check, a T_c census, node routing, and a long-trail trap test; kernels: limb-for-limb Python ports of the generated field kernels (asserting every no-overflow step) checked against big integers and affine secp256k1, the shipped counted loops and emitter wrappers executed by an AArch64 interpreter (including reductions whose final fold fires), instruction counts parsed from the shipped assembly, and the work-meter ledger recomputed from the prices and rows of proof.md. The toy run does not meter production instructions or implement 2^20 concurrent walks.
